scripts.check_all: node --run format && node --run check && node --run test && concurrently -g -n seed,e2e "node --run db:seed:check" "node --run test:e2e"
scripts.preview: node --run build && node --run db:migrate:local && vite preview
scripts.e2e:prepare: node --run build -- --mode e2e && rm -rf .cloudflare/e2e && node db/d1.ts migrations apply --local --persist-to .cloudflare/e2e/template
scripts.db:seed:check: rm -rf .cloudflare/seed-check && node db/d1.ts migrations apply --local --persist-to .cloudflare/seed-check && node db/d1.ts raw --local --persist-to .cloudflare/seed-check --sql @db/seed.sql
